title.en: A visit to a village fair

text.en: The mela has come to town. Nita and Radha are ready, with water bottles and a special bag. Dadiji agrees to come.

A mela is a fair where many people come together to have fun, shop and meet friends.
Nita and Radha are getting ready to go to the mela. It is far away, so they must take a bus.
Dadiji says her legs hurt, but Nita's father says, “We will take care of you.” She comes along.
They fill water bottles and take their special bag.
Neighbours Sneha and Rohit, and Mohan Chacha with his family, will join them. Mohan Chacha will come by city bus and autorickshaw.
Bus number 401 stops. The conductor and Nita's father help Dadiji get on. There is a seat reserved for older people.
How do you prepare for a trip? Take water, a bag, money and tell elders.
